name: Water Breathing
body:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 368
School transmutation; Level alchemist 3, arcanist 3, bloodrager 3, cleric 3, druid 3, hunter 3, investigator 3, magus 3, oracle 3, psychic 3, redmantisassassin 3, shaman 3, sorcerer 3, summoner 3, summoner (unchained) 3, warpriest 3, wizard 3
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (short reed or piece of straw)
Effect
Range touch
Target living creatures touched
Duration 2 hours/level; see text
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Description
The transmuted creatures can breathe water freely. Divide the duration evenly among all the creatures you touch. The spell does not make creatures unable to breathe air.
